description: This file defines an abstract class 'HonoSampler' for use with Apache JMeter, extending JMeter's 'AbstractSampler'. It manages server options, properties such as host, port, user credentials, trust store path, as well as semaphore management for concurrent access control. It includes an internal enum for endpoint types and methods for configuring, modifying, and managing the sampler's state within JMeter test scripts.

classes.name: HonoSampler
classes.description: An abstract JMeter sampler class for Hono endpoints, managing configuration properties, semaphores, and server options for Hono communication.

methods.name: modifyServerOptions
methods.description: Copies server configuration from the UI panel to the sampler properties.

methods.name: configureServerOptions
methods.description: Copies sampler properties to the server options UI panel.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Retrieves the trust store path property.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the trust store path property.

methods.name: getPortAsInt
methods.description: Converts port property string to integer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Constructs a full address string from endpoint and tenant properties.

methods.name: addSemaphore
methods.description: Increments the semaphore count for the current address in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getSemaphores
methods.description: Retrieves the current semaphore count for the address.

methods.name: removeSemaphores
methods.description: Resets semaphore count for the address to zero.
